note: Live-calibrated 2026-09-13 on 530 alerts with +30 min outcomes from the first 24 h of the engine (docs/CALLS.md, 'Why these thresholds'): the +30 min price is below the alert price for 85 % of alerts and the >=2x-at-+30 rate equals the base rate, so the channel posts fewer, better-shaped calls until the 14-day model lands. Negatives with strong evidence: breadth < 2 source coins (n=94: 0 % up 50 %, mean -46 %), age < 180 s (n=340: median -56 %, mean -28 %), bundle >= 3 or launch farm (n=112: mean -32 %). max 2 calls/hour, p >= 0.45. Positive cells so far are means driven by a few runners (age 180-600 s mean +20 %, dev 0.5-2 % mean +18 %, graduated-stage alerts mean +17 %) and need more data before they become requirements.
